subject: Medivault: on-prem demo — timing conflict and provisioning note
messages:
From: Samantha Ross <samantha.ross@medivault.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for on-prem demo & POC — Redwood

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intake form — I booked the self-serve on-prem demo slot but wanted to follow up with a bit more context from our side. Medivault is evaluating a private deployment for an upcoming regulatory pilot (HIPAA-like controls). Our security and procurement teams will want to review scope before a full pilot.

Quick details:
- Pilot goal: ingest and serve patient triage prompts for internal clinicians (low latency, high availability).
- Expected steady-state: ~6 concurrent sessions, ~1k tokens/session average.
- Data controls: customer-managed KMS, strict audit logs required.

Can we lock a 60–75 minute technical kick-off next week so our security lead (Daniel Park) can join? The self-serve calendar shows a 10:00–11:00 PST slot on Nov 17; that works for our PM, but Daniel is only available after 11:30 PST. If possible, can you (or your SDR) propose a 90-minute window later in the day or an alternative on Nov 18?

Attaching our one-page scope doc for context (medivault_poc_scope.pdf).

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Ross
Director of Security & Risk
Medivault

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ross <samantha.ross@medivault.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for on-prem demo & POC — Redwood

Hi Samantha — thanks for the scope doc and the heads-up. Looping in Aditya (SDR) to help coordinate schedule and Marissa (sales lead) for procurement/contract questions.

Proposed options (all PST):
- Tue Nov 16, 2:00–3:30 PM (90 min)
- Wed Nov 17, 12:00–1:30 PM (90 min) — note this is tight for us with Seattle offices but possible
- Thu Nov 18, 10:30–12:00 PM (90 min)

If Daniel needs to join after 11:30 on the 17th specifically, the 12:00 slot on Wed gives him the 1st half-hour buffer. Otherwise, Thu 10:30 might be the safest. Please confirm preferred option and final attendee list (names/roles). We’ll send a calendar invite with the technical agenda and an ops pre-checklist.

For transparency I attached our on-prem pricing workbook and a calendar placeholder (redwood_onprem_pricing.xlsx, calendar.ics). I also added the HubSpot deal HB-8342 so we can track procurement.

- Ben

Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 13:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for on-prem demo & POC — Redwood

Hi Samantha — quick intake follow-up from our side. Thanks for sharing the scope. A couple of asks so the demo is productive and we can provision an appropriate environment: 

Pre-demo checklist (we’ll run a quick ops preflight 24–48 hours prior):
- Confirm expected peak RPS and average sequence length (tokens) — you mentioned ~1k tokens/session; is that max or average?
- Confirm whether Medivault will bring a customer-managed KMS key (Y/N) and the KMS vendor (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM).
- Provide the list of attendees and their Slack/email for access coordination (Daniel Park especially).
- Any IP/data-sovereignty constraints (e.g., data must remain in our VPC, not replicated off-site).

We host the on-prem control plane package and can run the demo against a sandbox instance if you prefer. If procurement prefers a marketplace procurement route instead of an enterprise contract, please let us know — I can loop in the AWS Marketplace contact.

Sharing a short ops checklist link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Once you confirm the slot, I’ll create the calendar invite and collect required pre-demo evidence (SOC2 summary, audit log sample).

— Aditya
Aditya Rao | Solutions SDR
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Ross <samantha.ross@medivault.com>

Subject: Re: Request for on-prem demo & POC — Redwood

Thanks — appreciate the options and the checklist.

We’ll take Wed Nov 17 but need to shift it 90 minutes later so Daniel can join. Can you move the 12:00–1:30 PM slot to 1:30–3:00 PM PST instead? That would give us all three stakeholders present (PM, security lead, procurement observer). If that exact slot is not possible, Thu Nov 18 10:30–12:00 is our fallback.

Attendees (confirming):
- Samantha Ross — Director, Security & Risk (host)
- Daniel Park — Security Lead (will own KMS/controls)
- Priya Patel — Procurement (observer)

I’ve attached an updated calendar stub from our side (calendar.ics) and will add the final call invite once you confirm.

Also — one procurement note: if we go the AWS Marketplace route, procurement will still need a Redwood contact for invoicing and SOC2 evidence. I saw the HubSpot link you shared (HB-8342) — happy to accept a marketplace listing if that speeds POC procurement.

Regards,
Samantha
